Resolves #21790

🌿 A resize can no longer leave a dialog fainter than it found it.

A dialog that never moved now gets its own opacity back when a resize ends, committed or cancelled with Escape; it used to keep the gesture's 0.3. `Resizable#closeGesture` deleted `style.opacity` when the owner's style held none, and a single-node owner keeps a deleted key's last value (`component.Base#style_`), so the method now writes `null`, which removes the key. The engine side shrinks from five lines to two. Regression from #21283.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e on `examples/dialog`, red on base and green at the head) → L3 required (the rendered opacity of a single-node component; the unit stub, a plain object, could not show it). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: restoration — one method's restore line, plus its tests.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 a resize of a dialog that never moved, committed or cancelled, ends at its opacity | `e2e/dialog/MoveResize.spec.mjs` › "Escape cancels a resize of a dialog that never moved, and its opacity comes back" and › "a resize of a dialog that never moved ends at its opacity". CI: e2e-engine. |
| AC-2 the moved dialog's cancel test still passes | `MoveResize.spec.mjs` › "Escape cancels a resize: the moved dialog keeps its size and its opacity once the preview is gone". CI: e2e-engine. |
| AC-3 both new tests red on the unfixed engine and green with the fix; `e2e/dialog/` passes | Local: both red with `src/plugin/Resizable.mjs` at base (`Expected: "1"`, `Received: "0.3"`); at the head `e2e/dialog/` 14 of 14. |

## Deltas from ticket
- `unit/plugin/Resizable.spec.mjs`'s stub owner is a plain object, which accepted the delete, so its "none" case expected no `opacity` key. It now expects `opacity: null`.

All coverage runs in CI; the red-on-base receipt is AC-3's row.
